summary: A setting that is on or off, and that a form submits while it is on.

required.description: The form cannot be submitted while the setting is off.

value.description: Submitted with the name while the setting is on.

name.description: The name the value is submitted under.

disabled.description: It cannot be changed or focused.

root.note: Holds the author's label text and draws no face and no focus ring of its own.

track.note: checked: face solid. The full icon size of ui-geometry tall (a.full, one q more than a.md), and 7/4 of that wide. Keyboard focus draws the ring round it, following its pill.

thumb.note: Sits at the start of the track when off and at the end when on, g_c inside it at either end; it grows by the same q as the track. The raised face alone: no line or shadow of its own.

events.input: Dispatched when the user toggles the setting.
events.change: Dispatched after input, when the user toggles the setting.
